explosives.Name: Alchemist's Fire
explosives.Description: This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites when exposed to air.
explosives.Effects: As an action, you can throw this flask up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. [p]Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the alchemist's fire as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. [p]A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

explosives.Name: Alchemist's Tinder
explosives.Description: This 6-inch-long, square wooden rod is coated with a dry alchemical substance, which is then coated with a layer of wax.
explosives.Effects: When the wax is scraped away to expose the alchemical substance to air, the substance ignites a minute later with intense heat and burns for 5 minutes. [p]The fire is unaffected by wind or precipitation and inflicts 1d6 points of fire damage each round to anything touching it. It is primarily used to light fires in difficult conditions.

explosives.Name: Dragon Egg
explosives.Description: This small iron-bound wooden cask is filled with an alchemical mix of strange powders and liquids. It smells very strongly of sulfur. A fuse protrudes from the top of the cask. The cask weighs 20 lbs.
explosives.Effects: Once lit, the fuse burns quickly. 1d4 + 1 rounds after you ignite the fuse, the cask explodes. Each creature in a 20-foot radius must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. [p]If the dragon's egg cask suffers any fire or lightning damage, it explodes at the end of the next round.
explosives.IdentifySays: [i]Potion Type:[/i] Alchemist[br][i]Essence(s)[/i]: Earth, Fire, Shadow[br][i]Spell:[/i] none detected

explosives.Name: Flash Pellet
explosives.Description: brown, walnut-sized pellet of what appears to be packed sawdust.
explosives.Effects: When thrown against a hard surface, this pellet explodes in a blinding flash of light.  Each creature in a 5-foot radius must succeed at a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avert their gaze or are blinded for 1 round and suffer disadvantage on any attack rolls or Wisdom (Perception) checks based on sight 1 round additional round after that. Creatures with a vulnerability to bright light have disadvantage on this save.

explosives.Name: Gunpowder
explosives.Description: Gunpowder is chiefly used to propel a bullet from the barrel of a pistol or rifle, or it is formed into a bomb. Gunpowder is stored in small wooden kegs and water resistant powder horns.
explosives.Effects: Setting fire to a container full of gunpowder can cause it to explode, dealing fire damage to creatures within 10 feet of it (3d6 for a powder horn, 7d6 for a keg). A successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw halves the damage. [p]Setting fire to an ounce of gunpowder causes it to flare for 1 round, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

explosives.Name: Morning Star
explosives.Description: An orb about 4 inches in diameter, made of metal or some other hard material. It has several small holes that allow the vapors from it's contents to escape.
explosives.Effects: As an action, you can throw this grenade at a point up to 30 feet away. At the start of your next turn, it emits an opaque cloud of poisonous gas filling a 20-foot radius sphere. Each creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 12) or become poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can make the saving throw again at the start of each of its turns, ending the poisoned condition on a success. [p]Additionally, the gas ignites violently on contact with an open flame, and each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 4d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The gas dissipates naturally over a period of up to 1 minute, depending on the wind conditions.
explosives.IdentifySays: [i]Potion Type:[/i] Alchemist[br][i]Essence(s)[/i]: Air, Shadow[br][i]Spell:[/i] none detected

explosives.Name: Poison Smoke
explosives.Description: A vail containing a grey, swirling, mist.
explosives.Effects: As an action, you can throw this vial up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a creature, treating the poison smoke as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 13) or become poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can make the saving throw again at the start of each of its turns, ending the poisoned condition if successful Creatures that don’t need to breathe or are immune to poison automatically succeed on this saving throw.

explosives.Name: Smokestick
explosives.Description: A small stick about 1/2 inch in diameter and 12 inches in length that has clearly been treated with some sort of grease.
explosives.Effects: When ignited, it instantly creates thick, opaque smoke. [p]As an action, you can snap the end to expose a primer of alchemist's fire and throw it up to 30 feet. When the smokestick lands, it emits a cloud of smoke that heavily obscures the area in a 10-foot cube. [p]The stick is consumed after 1 round, and the smoke dissipates naturally over a period of up to 1 minute, depending on the wind conditions.

explosives.Name: Tanglefoot Bag
explosives.Description: A sealed canvas bag that appears to be about 1' in diameter. When jostled, it appears to contain some form of goo.
explosives.Effects: This fragile sack contains coiled strands of fibrous alchemical goo that expand and become sticky when exposed to air. [p]As an action, you can throw the bag up to 30 feet, causing an effect identical to the web spell (DC 12), filling a 5- foot cube, for 1 minute. [p]Large creatures have advantage on saving throws against the effects of the goo. Huge or larger creatures are unaffected. The bag does not function underwater.

explosives.Name: Thunderstone
explosives.Effects: Shatters upon striking a hard surface, creating a deafening bang audible out to 500 feet. [p]As an action, you can throw the thunderstone up to 30 feet. Each creature in a 15-foot radius of the point of impact must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be deafened for one minute.

explosives.Name: Pomander of Warding
explosives.Description: A ball of aromatic spices and perfumes contained in a loose-weave cloth bag.  Normally wrapped tightly in parchment to keep the contents from seeping out until ready for use.
explosives.Effects: Once unwrapped,  it fills an area in a 15-foot radius with a strong aroma for 8 hours.[p]Undead creatures of CR 2 or lower that enter this area must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be turned as detailed in the Turn Undead cleric feature.
explosives.IdentifySays: [i]Potion Type:[/i] Herbalist[br][i]Essence(s)[/i]: Air, Shadow[br][i]Spell:[/i] none detected
